label: NetEngine A816 E IPv6+ access router
description: Huawei NetEngine A816 E - 1U fanless IPv6+ access router, 120 Gbit/s, eight service ports: 4x GE/FE optical and 4x GE/FE electrical. SRv6 and MPLS modes are switchable per box.
notes: Datasheet V800R024C10, "Interface Type: 4*GE/FE (optical) + 4*GE/FE (electrical)" - eight service ports in total, which is what the hardware guide quotes as the maximum number of physical ports. 1U, 320 x 220 x 43.6 mm, 24 W typical, natural convection (no fan), -5 to 50 C, single AC / dual AC / AC+DC. NAT is rated 600 Mbps and IPsec 300 Mbps at 512-byte packets - forwarding numbers, not port features, so they are recorded here rather than as capabilities. No PoE on any port. FE is a software rate on each GE port rather than a separate interface. MPLS and SRv6 are switchable modes: one box cannot run LDP and SRv6 in the same instance.
